title: Label events don't start Backend CI: apply test-new-events-schema before ready_for_review or push
answers: I added test-new-events-schema but CI didn't rerun
When should I apply the new events schema label on a PR?
Why does labeling not trigger Backend CI?
body:
The `pull_request` trigger in `.github/workflows/ci-backend.yml` uses `types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]`, so `labeled` does not start it. A label takes effect on the next push or ready_for_review.
- Convention (AGENTS.md, PR template): add `test-new-events-schema` while the PR is a draft so ready_for_review starts the run.
- If the PR must open ready, label immediately and push another commit.
- Report the classification result under 'How did you test this code?'.
- Don't add `labeled` to the trigger types: unrelated labels would rerun the matrices on already-covered commits.
applies: Agent/human PR workflow for backend PRs
